# DSG (Dynamic Scene Graph intention dataset)

Scene-graph intention data constructed from selected Action Genome videos.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** Observed person-object relationships and the context preceding a scripted action.

**Output / label:** An action-intention category, such as dressing or tidying.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://github.com/Tong0720/STGAIN)

**Example evidence:** [code](https://github.com/Tong0720/STGAIN), [paper](https://orca.cardiff.ac.uk/174841/1/1-s2.0-S0957417424030148-main.pdf)

## Intention in this dataset

Intention classes are extracted from scripts describing an action beginning; they are behavior-derived operational labels, not reported mental states.

**Relevance:** `explicit` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2025

**Domains:** daily_activities, human_object_interaction  
**Intention types:** action, object_interaction  
**Tasks:** intention_recognition  
**Modalities:** rgb, text, object_state  
**Formats:** video, text, structured_annotation
